penalties.comment: A missed_health_risk is any scenario where should_escalate is true but the agent chose not to escalate. Penalized far more than a false escalation to reflect that under-escalating a disinfection failure can hurt people.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Chlorine came back at 0.18 today. Yesterday it was fine. Cylinder scale still shows plenty of gas.

expected.diagnosis: Free chlorine below the 0.3 mg/L health-critical limit despite gas available; suspect injector vacuum line leak/blockage or stuck rotameter per Page 3A.
expected.escalation_reason: Rule 1A: chlorine below 0.3 mg/L means water may not be disinfected.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Turbidity reading is 0.42 this morning. Water looks a little cloudy but not bad.

expected.diagnosis: Turbidity in the warning band (0.3-0.99 NTU); filter nearing breakthrough. Schedule a backwash per Page 4A.
expected.escalation_reason: Warning band only, not an ESCALATE reading. Handle locally with a backwash.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Turbidity is 1.3 NTU and chlorine is 0.9. The filter was backwashed two days ago.

expected.diagnosis: Turbidity at/above 1.0 NTU shortly after a backwash suggests channeled or exhausted media per Page 4B.
expected.escalation_reason: Rule 1B: turbidity at or above 1.0 NTU can shield pathogens; also Page 4B media inspection.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Chlorine has been slipping: 1.4 three days ago, 1.1 two days ago, 0.8 yesterday, 0.6 today. Still above the limit though.

expected.diagnosis: Drift 2A chlorine decline over consecutive days; developing demand or chlorinator feed drifting down. Still in normal range today.
expected.escalation_reason: No reading is in an ESCALATE band yet. Advisory drift warning; investigate injector feed per Page 3A before it crosses 0.3.

training_scenarios.operator_report: I smell a sharp chlorine smell near the cylinder and there's a hissing sound.

expected.diagnosis: Suspected chlorine gas leak at the cylinder per Page 3D — immediate safety event.
expected.escalation_reason: Page 3D: visible/smelled gas leak is immediate evacuation and RMW call. Do not repair alone.

training_scenarios.operator_report: pH reads 6.3 today. Soda ash day tank looks low.

expected.diagnosis: Low pH below 6.5 (corrosive water) with soda ash day tank low per Page 5A.
expected.escalation_reason: Rule 1A/Page 5A: pH below 6.5 escalates. Refill soda ash and increase feed, but report same day.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Pump is cycling on and off every minute or so. Readings all look normal.

expected.diagnosis: Rapid pump cycling indicates a waterlogged pressure tank or failed bladder per Page 6A.
expected.escalation_reason: Not health-critical by itself. Log it and schedule service.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Chlorine is 0.1 and turbidity is 1.1 at the same time this morning.

expected.diagnosis: Simultaneous chlorine below 0.3 and turbidity at/above 1.0 — disinfection failure. Boil-water notice considered per Rule 1C.
expected.escalation_reason: Rules 1A, 1B and 1C all trip at once. Most severe case; consider boil-water notice.

training_scenarios.operator_report: We just got power back after an outage. Haven't sent water to town yet. What do I check?

expected.diagnosis: Post-outage restart per Page 6C — confirm residual before distributing, run to waste until residual is in normal range (0.5-2.0).
expected.escalation_reason: Residual is low-normal but recovering; procedure handles it locally. Run to waste first. No ESCALATE reading.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Chlorine is high today, reads 4.3. I didn't change anything.

expected.diagnosis: High chlorine above 4.0 mg/L per Page 3E; reduce rotameter feed, suspect regulator stuck open if it stays high.
expected.escalation_reason: Rule 1A upper bound: chlorine above 4.0 mg/L escalates; regulator may be stuck open.

training_scenarios.operator_report: The filter needed backwashing four times this month. It used to last almost a month between backwashes.

expected.diagnosis: Short filter runs per Page 4C — suspect source water change or failing media. Recurring problem.
expected.escalation_reason: Page 4C/Page 7: a recurring problem the operator cannot resolve should be flagged to the RMW.

training_scenarios.operator_report: Chlorine reads 0.45. A touch low but water's clear.

expected.diagnosis: Chlorine in the warning band (0.3-0.49) but above the escalate limit. Check injector feed per Page 3A and recheck.
expected.escalation_reason: Warning band only. Above the 0.3 ESCALATE limit. Investigate feed locally and monitor.

test_scenarios.operator_report: Chlorine is 0.28 this morning. Cylinder scale shows it's almost empty.

expected.diagnosis: Chlorine below 0.3 with cylinder near empty per Page 3B — switch to standby cylinder, never run without confirmed residual.
expected.escalation_reason: Rule 1A: 0.28 is below the 0.3 ESCALATE limit.

test_scenarios.operator_report: Turbidity has risen three days running: 0.15, 0.22, 0.29. Still clear-ish.

expected.diagnosis: Drift 2B turbidity climb over 3 days; filter nearing breakthrough. Schedule a backwash per Page 4A.
expected.escalation_reason: Advisory drift; no ESCALATE reading. Backwash locally.

test_scenarios.operator_report: pH jumped from 7.2 yesterday to 8.6 today.

expected.diagnosis: pH above 8.5 per Page 5B plus a Drift 2C swing greater than 0.5 units in a day; reduce soda ash feed.
expected.escalation_reason: Rule 1A: pH above 8.5 escalates and reduces chlorine effectiveness.
